accounts.label: first subscription
accounts._comment: default layout: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR stays UNSET, so its json is ~/.claude.json (NOT ~/.claude/.claude.json) and its Keychain service is the un-suffixed 'Claude Code-credentials'.

accounts.label: second subscription
accounts._comment: non-default: launched with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<dir>. It has its own Keychain item, Claude Code-credentials-<sha256(dir)[:8]>, so its normal login is used. Optional tokenRef (a 1Password CLI secret reference) is only a fallback for hosts with no Keychain; a `claude setup-token` token cannot read /api/oauth/usage.

share._comment: Paths under the config dir that are account-agnostic. Every non-primary seat gets a symlink to the primary's copy. Never list .credentials.json or .claude.json here.
share._comment2: Keys inside <configDir>/.claude.json copied from the primary to the others. mcpServers is user-scope MCP; settings.json cannot hold it.
